metadata.question: Were there fires visible in a 50 mile radius around (latitude: 34.498828, longitude: -112.246886) between June 20, 2017 and June 30, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use MODIS Burned Area MCD64A1 v6.1 (MODIS/061/MCD64A1) filtered to June 2017 and within 50-mile radius of the point. If unavailable, fallback to v6 (MODIS/006/MCD64A1).
- Compute day-of-year range for 2017-06-20 to 2017-06-30 and check burned pixels whose burnDate falls within this range.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not cloud-based. Use burnDate band and mask to DOY window. Count valid pixels and burned pixels; compute burned area.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty: C1.
- If valid pixel count is 0: C2.
- If any reduceRegion returns null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise, if burned pixel count > 0: A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to evaluate server objects as Promises
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate(resolve, reject);
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lon = -112.246886;
    const lat = 34.498828;
    const milesToMeters = 1609.344;
    const radiusM = 50 * milesToMeters; // 50 miles
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
    const region = point.buffer(radiusM);

    const startDate = ee.Date('2017-06-20');
    const endDate = ee.Date('2017-06-30'); // inclusive
    const monthStart = ee.Date('2017-06-01');
    const monthEnd = ee.Date('2017-07-01'); // exclusive

    const doyStart = ee.Number.parse(startDate.format('D'));
    const doyEnd = ee.Number.parse(endDate.format('D'));

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(monthStart, monthEnd).filterBounds(region);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Fallback to v6
      datasetId = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(monthStart, monthEnd).filterBounds(region);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('Collection v6.1 Images: 0');
        console.log('Collection v6 Images: 0');
        console.log('No images found for the location/date window.');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found)');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      } else {
        console.log('Collection v6.1 Images: 0');
        console.log(`Collection v6 Images: ${size}`);
      }
    } else {
      console.log(`Collection v6.1 Images: ${size}`);
    }

    const img = col.first();
    const bandNames = await getInfoAsync(img.bandNames());
    // Try to find the burn date band name robustly
    let burnBand = null;
    if (bandNames && bandNames.indexOf('burnDate') !== -1) burnBand = 'burnDate';
    else if (bandNames && bandNames.indexOf('BurnDate') !== -1) burnBand = 'BurnDate';

    if (!burnBand) {
      console.log(`Band names: ${JSON.stringify(bandNames)}`);
      console.log('Could not find burn date band.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: Valid pixel count and burn window mask
    const burnDate = img.select(burnBand);
    const validCount = await getInfoAsync(
      burnDate.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(burnBand)
    );

    if (validCount === null || validCount === undefined) {
      console.log('Valid pixel count: null');
      console.log('C3: Calculation failure (null result)');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (Number(validCount) === 0) {
      console.log('Valid pixel count: 0 (region outside coverage or invalid)');
      console.log('C2: No valid pixels in region after processing');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const inRangeMask = burnDate.gte(doyStart).and(burnDate.lte(doyEnd));
    const burnedMask = inRangeMask.selfMask();

    const burnCount = await getInfoAsync(
      burnedMask.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(burnBand)
    );

    // Burned area (km²)
    const burnAreaM2 = await getInfoAsync(
      ee.Image.pixelArea()
        .updateMask(burnedMask)
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        })
        .get('area')
    );

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    const doyStartVal = await getInfoAsync(doyStart);
    const doyEndVal = await getInfoAsync(doyEnd);

    console.log(`Region: 50 mi radius around (${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lon.toFixed(6)})`);
    console.log(`Date window: 2017-06-20 to 2017-06-30 (DOY ${doyStartVal}–${doyEndVal})`);
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${datasetId}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels (500–1000m scale): ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Burn pixels in window: ${burnCount || 0}`);
    const areaKm2 = burnAreaM2 ? (burnAreaM2 / 1e6) : 0;
    console.log(`Burned area in window (km²): ${areaKm2.toFixed(2)}`);

    if (burnCount === null || burnCount === undefined) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    if (Number(burnCount) > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
